analysis.title: Woodward Inc. (WWD): Remains one of the best long-term growth stories in the industry; Buy
key_insights: GS stays Buy on Woodward after F4Q26 earnings. It cites the aerospace, defense and industrial component business, content gains on next-generation aircraft and engines, exposure to the power build-out, and margin opportunity.
F4Q26 adjusted EPS was $2.83 against FactSet consensus of $2.54 and GS estimate of $2.57. Total revenue was 1.5% above consensus and in line with the GS estimate, at $1,160mn, up 16.6% yoy.
By end market, aerospace aftermarket revenue rose 25% yoy and aerospace OE rose 26%. Defense aftermarket fell 12% and defense OE rose 11%.
Segment operating margin was 23.2%, 85 bps above consensus, 60 bps above the GS estimate and up 86 bps yoy. Segment EBIT was 5% above consensus.

Industrial EBIT margin was 20.7%, 240 bps above the GS estimate and up 610 bps yoy, on higher volumes and price realization partly offset by inflation. Aerospace EBIT margin was 24.3%, 30 bps below the GS estimate and down 10 bps yoy.

FY2027 guidance: total revenue +6-10% (consensus +8.8%), EPS $10.20-$10.70 (consensus $10.74), free cash flow $400-450mn (consensus $499mn), capex about $290mn (consensus $232mn). Guidance is below consensus on EPS and free cash flow and above on capex.

GS argues the growth drivers are still early. LEAP is in the early years of engine aftermarket with decades of visibility, and the power build is early. GS also says WWD guides conservatively, so initial next-year guidance can be a clearing event.
GS says valuation is close to the average of its aerospace supply chain coverage despite a stronger multi-year fundamental story.
GS raised its 12-month price target to $487 from $478, based on 27.5x FY2027E EV/EBITDA (unchanged). Upside to the $335.72 price is 45.1%.

GS cut FY2027E EPS to $11.12 from $11.34 and raised FY2028E to $13.48 from $13.44. FY2029E moves to $15.93 from $15.66 and FY2030E to $18.42 from $17.90. FY2027E and FY2028E revenue were cut to $4,785.7mn and $5,323.3mn from $4,834.0mn and $5,377.3mn.

market_movers.rationale: GS stays Buy after a F4Q26 EPS and margin beat and raises the target to $487 from $478 on 27.5x FY2027E EV/EBITDA. It cites aerospace aftermarket growth, content gains and the power build-out.

earnings_insights: WWD F4Q26 adjusted EPS $2.83 reported vs FactSet consensus $2.54 and GS estimate $2.57, up 35.3% from $2.09 in F4Q25.
F4Q26 total revenue $1,160.2mn reported vs GS estimate $1,160.7mn, up 16.6% yoy. The report says revenue was 1.5% above consensus.
F4Q26 segment operating margin 23.2% reported vs GS estimate 22.6%, up from 21.1% in F4Q25. Aerospace margin was 24.3% and industrial margin 20.7%.
F4Q26 free cash flow was $131mn reported vs $181mn a year ago.

FY2027 company guidance: revenue +6-10% yoy (consensus +8.8%), aerospace revenue +8-13% with a 23.8-24.3% margin, industrial revenue +1-5% with an 18.2-18.7% margin. EPS $10.20-$10.70 (consensus $10.74), free cash flow $400-450mn (consensus $499mn), capex about $290mn (consensus $232mn), tax rate about 22%, about 60mn shares.
GS FY2027E-FY2030E adjusted EPS estimates are $11.12/$13.48/$15.93/$18.42, from $11.34/$13.44/$15.66/$17.90 previously.
